comment.body: BLOCKING REVIEW at exact HEAD f88e428d16b64c4628befa433e93ebcb2d3b8404. In AsyncScene/Web/ui/mobile-ui.css, selector `#blocks[data-active-tab="dm"] > #dmBlock{display:flex!important}` overrides the game's `.hidden{display:none!important}`. `ui-dm.js::closeDM()` sets S.dm.open=false and adds `.hidden`; `UI.renderDM` explicitly hides DM until opened and the original HTML starts #dmBlock hidden. As implemented, choosing the DM tab forces the entire closed DM panel visible, potentially exposing its composer before an authorized DM. Also audit forced `display:flex!important` on active #battlesBody/#eventsBody against their .hidden logic. Codex: keep visible three-tab navigation but preserve logical open/closed and progressive-disclosure state of panel CONTENT; a closed DM may display an empty/disabled placeholder if needed, not actionable DM controls. Add an EXECUTED browser regression of fresh S.dm.open=false, UI.closeDM(), then legitimate UI.openDM() with tab selection, plus hidden battle/events bodies. Update Web/docs pairs and CI in SAME PR #430, return new exact SHA. Do not merge or claim Safari PASS. Scope/security and desktop invariants remain.

issue.body:
## Summary
Mobile-first three-tab panel layout for the approved design. Desktop presentation remains unchanged; the existing game panels stay mounted, with visibility and accessibility state controlled by a small mobile-only UI controller.

## Base and exact implementation HEAD
- Base: `main` at `0d9dd246bb37444bf5073363c4e499393f0b80ff`
- Branch: `codex/mobile-first-interface-redesign-20261014`
- Exact HEAD: `f88e428d16b64c4628befa433e93ebcb2d3b8404`
- Two commits: implementation and a test-only viewport restoration; no merge performed.

## Changed files
- `AsyncScene/Web/index.html`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/mobile-ui.css`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-core.js`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-mobile.js`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-dm.js`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-battles.js`
- `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-events.js`
- `docs/index.html`
- `docs/ui/mobile-ui.css`
- `docs/ui/ui-core.js`
- `docs/ui/ui-mobile.js`
- `docs/ui/ui-dm.js`
- `docs/ui/ui-battles.js`
- `docs/ui/ui-events.js`
- `tools/serve_mobile_interface_test.py`
- `tools/test_mobile_first_interface.html`
- `tools/test_mobile_first_interface_contract.py`

The new CSS is isolated in `mobile-ui.css`; the accepted `style-base.css` bytes remain unchanged. Source/deployed mirrors are byte-identical for all files above that have a paired copy. Existing unrelated `ui-boot.js` source/docs drift is untouched.

## Mobile render paths
- Statistics/menu: existing `#topBar` and `#menuBlock`, fixed within the mobile safe-area viewport.
- Chat: existing `#left`, `#chatLog`, `#chatInputRow`; remains visible above the resize handle.
- Tabs and content: new `#mobilePanelShell` contains the three-button tablist and existing `#blocks` with `#dmBlock`, `#battlesBlock`, and `#eventsBlock`.
- Existing `UI.renderDM`, `UI.renderBattles`, and Events rendering continue to own their panel data/actions. The tab controller changes CSS visibility/ARIA only and does not call renderers.
- The tab badges mirror existing `dmHeaderCount`, `battleCount`, and `eventsHeaderCount` DOM counters via MutationObserver. New events do not change the selected tab.

## Tabs and gestures
- One tap selects a tab; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard navigation updates `aria-selected`, roving tabindex, and linked tabpanel semantics.
- Swipe recognition is limited to the active panel body's content area. Horizontal predominance and a 56px threshold are required; vertical scrolling, buttons/actions, horizontal scrollers, chat, and the tab strip are excluded. Pointer cancel and capture loss clear the gesture. A horizontal drag that starts on an action is prevented from falling through as an accidental click.
- Panel DOM remains mounted, preserving drafts/open cards/actions. Scroll positions are saved/restored per panel.

## Chat resize, keyboard, and safe areas
- Reuses the existing `#chatResizeHandle` and `UI.ensureMobilePinnedChatLayout()`; no second resize controller was added.
- The divider allocates the remaining visual viewport between chat and the active-panel shell, with 55/45 reading and 40/60 active-battle starting guides, minimum sizes, pointer cancellation, keyboard arrows/Home/End, and page-session-only manual sizing. No game-save preference is written.
- Layout recalculates on VisualViewport/window resize/scroll, orientation change, pageshow, visibility return, and chat input focus. It accounts for safe-area insets and uses dynamic viewport sizing plus internal scrolling.

## Long-press help and toast separation
- Existing desktop hover/focus hints remain in their current implementation. On mobile, a 520ms hold on a hint-bearing surface opens a distinct accessible hint; movement cancels it, while a short tap retains its immediate action.
- Context-menu prevention is limited to hint-bearing surfaces. Toast nodes are excluded from the long-press hint lifecycle. No toast TTL, reward, money/REP, win logic, or `COALESCE_MS = 90` change is included.

## Validation results
- `python3 -m unittest tools/test_mobile_first_interface_contract.py -v`: PASS (9 tests).
- `python3 tools/test_stage6_instant_stat_hover_hints.py`: PASS (11 tests, including five-profile hints, independent stat toast identity/dismissal, and no automatic dismissal).
- `python3 tools/test_stage6_step9_click_persistent_stat_toast.py`: PASS.
- `python3 tools/test_stage6_step9_five_profile_runtime_defects.py`: PASS (7 tests).
- `python3 tools/test_stage7_15_boot_mirror_contract.py`: PASS.
- `python3 tools/test_stage7_15_82_visible_first_event_entry.py`: PASS.
- Git-backed Stage 7.15 scope scripts `test_stage7_15_30_oleg_dm.py` and `test_stage7_15_50_progressive_disclosure.py` require `git diff origin/main`; they could not run in the extracted baseline snapshot used for isolated validation.
- `node --check` for changed UI JavaScript modules: PASS.
- `git diff --cached --check` in a temporary baseline-subset repository for all 17 changed paths: PASS.
- Stage 6.1 and 6.2 theme scripts were also run; both stop at their pre-existing pinned `style-base.css` blob expectation (`738398815ed6ca310a5e3dee0dbea2cd24729e89`). The verified base commit actually contains blob `5cf0f78219e3acb504d40fa9a7f4c0506885ff02`; this PR leaves that stylesheet byte-identical to the verified base. These stale assertions are not changed here.
- Codex In-app Browser regression page: `tools/test_mobile_first_interface.html`. Observed PASS at 390×844, 320px narrow width, 844×390 landscape, and a 390×420 keyboard-height viewport: pinned top/chat/tabs, one active panel, no horizontal page overflow, one-tap state preservation/no renderer calls, live counters, both swipe directions and edge stops, vertical scrolling, action protection, divider drag/keyboard bounds, short tap/long press/scroll cancellation, persistent toast behavior, desktop breakpoint, chat input/send recovery, and restored 390x844 mobile view after viewport restoration.
- Web/docs byte parity checks pass for paired mobile task files.

## Limits and CI
The Codex Browser harness simulates touch pointer events and viewport-height changes; it does not emulate physical iPhone touch hardware, iOS Safari, or the native iPhone keyboard. No Safari PASS is claimed. Required GitHub CI on the final HEAD completed successfully: `telemetry-receiver-checks` (run 80) and `ai-forensics-evidence` (run 1594).
